newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-DOLPHINS BEAT BILLS 16-14. [CORRECTED 07:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-DOLPHINS BEAT BILLS 16-14. [CORRECTED 07:40 GMT]

text.p: Joe Nedney kicked three field goals and Dan Marino threw a touchdown pass to O.J. McDuffie as the Miami Dolphins prevented the Buffalo Bills from clinching a playoff berth with a 16-14 victory on Monday.

Miami (7-8) won for just the second time in its last six home meetings against Buffalo (9-6). Buffalo's loss clinched the AFC East title for the New England Patriots. The Bills can secure a wild-card spot with a home win over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday, but will be out with a loss and a Jacksonville win.

Marino was 26-of-37 for 263 yards as the Dolphins dominated the time of possession, holding the ball for 41:59. Nedney kicked an 18-yard field goal to cap a 10-play 69-yard drive and give the Dolphins the lead for good, 9-7, 3:49 into the third quarter.
